note: 2026-11-28 (user): Readability v2 (docs/specials/READABILITY_V2_LOGIC.md). Every threshold of modules/ocr/readability.py; reloads on change. Rules, first that fires: R0 blank page -> Not Applicable; R1 min_tokens+ tokens and text_score >= good_text_score -> Yes; R2 visibility model not visible at p >= not_visible_at and (under min_tokens tokens or text_score < not_visible_text_score) -> No; R3 text_score < poor_text_score and (Final Quality Low or ocr_agreement < agreement.low_below) -> No; R4 under min_tokens tokens, ink on the page, sharpness < image.sharpness_below or contrast < image.contrast_below -> No; R5 -> Yes. text_score = (2 x word_score + ocr_agreement) / 3; word_score = mean of dictionary share, shape share (and Azure's mean word confidence when Azure read the page).
